topic: How to Clean a Wooden Cutting Board
notes: Food-safety guidance controls. Recommend hot soapy water after each use, rinsing and thorough drying. Keep raw-meat cross-contamination guidance explicit. Do not invent sanitizer ratios beyond the verified source, and if bleach sanitizing is mentioned, use only the exact source-supported dilution and never mix bleach with other cleaners. Replace boards that are excessively worn or have hard-to-clean grooves.
